description: Use this when someone planning posts, promotions or opening hours needs the public holidays, state holidays or big shopping/observance days for Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, Philippines, Thailand, United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia or the UAE, for example 'when is Hari Raya this year' or 'holidays in Malaysia next month'. Returns dates verified against the official government list and a second independent calendar, which regions/states each one applies to, and lunar holidays that are expected but not yet confirmed (clearly marked). Do not use it for other countries, for school terms, or to invent dates it doesn't return.

country.description: Country name or 2-letter code, e.g. Malaysia or MY

to.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD, optional (default a year from the start)

name: holiday_calendar
title: Holiday calendar
